_comment: Shared mecanum mixing behavioral fixtures. Values computed from the exact equations in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 4 via tests/fixtures/generate_mixing_fixtures.py and cross-checked by hand. firmware/tests/test_mixing/test_mixing.cpp asserts these same values against mix(). The dashboard/control workstream should reproduce identical values from its Python mock mixing implementation to keep parity (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 4: 'Use shared fixtures to verify Python/C++ output parity').

fixtures.name: zero_limit
fixtures.note: Explicit zero-limit handling: four zero outputs.

fixtures.name: forward_positive
fixtures.note: Logical-direction test: positive forward -> all four outputs positive.

fixtures.name: forward_negative
fixtures.note: Negative forward reverses all four outputs.

fixtures.name: sideways_positive
fixtures.note: Logical-direction test: positive sideways -> FL/RR positive, FR/RL negative.

fixtures.name: sideways_negative
fixtures.note: Negative sideways reverses the corresponding outputs.

fixtures.name: turn_positive
fixtures.note: Logical-direction test: positive turn -> FL/RL positive, FR/RR negative.

fixtures.name: turn_negative
fixtures.note: Negative turn reverses the corresponding outputs.

fixtures.name: diagonal_forward_right
fixtures.note: Forward/sideways magnitude exceeds 1; normalized before scaling, then saturation-scaled together.

fixtures.name: forward_plus_turn_saturates
fixtures.note: Raw outputs (200, 0, 200, 0) exceed the limit; all four scaled together by 0.5.

fixtures.name: all_axes_combined
fixtures.note: Combined translation and rotation; raw max magnitude (180) triggers proportional scaling before rounding.

fixtures.name: small_speed_limit
fixtures.note: Common wheel-output normalization boundary at the smallest nonzero limit.

fixtures.name: negative_turn_only_half
fixtures.note: Fractional turn input, no normalization or saturation triggered.
